title: God of War III Remastered
summary: Kratos's brutal revenge against the Greek gods of Olympus.

moments.label: Meeting the World Serpent
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus discover the giant serpent in the lake.

moments.label: Brokk's Workshop Upgrade
moments.detail: Brokk introduces his workshop and offers an upgrade to the axe.

moments.label: Poison Scorn Poles Encounter
moments.detail: Atreus and Kratos clear out noxious scorn poles in the foggy path.

moments.label: Sindri Meets Kratos
moments.detail: Sindri appears, criticizes the axe handle, and works on it.

moments.label: Revenants and Raging Beasts
moments.detail: Kratos and Atreus battle fierce enemies along the mountain path.

moments.label: The Black Breath Barrier
moments.detail: A mysterious dark barrier blocks the path forward to the mountain.

moments.label: Týr's Temple Revealed
moments.detail: The characters explore the newly revealed Týr's Temple on the lake.

moments.label: Turning the Great Bridge
moments.detail: Atreus uses his strength to push and align the massive bridge.

moments.label: The Bifrost and World Tree
moments.detail: The group learns how to use the Bifrost to travel between realms.

moments.label: Aligning the Realm Bridge
moments.detail: Kratos turns the wheel to align the bridge to the destination realm.

moments.label: Journey to Alfheim
moments.detail: The travelers open the bridge and step into the realm of Alfheim.

videos.title: God of War 4 Part 3 Jörmungandr (World Serpent) || SK._.LOGAN
videos.summary: Kratos and Atreus encounter the World Serpent and journey toward the mountain.
